mapper.select: select id, kb_id, doc_name, file_path, content_text, status, chunk_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_knowledge_doc where kb_id = #{kbId} order by id desc
mapper.insert: insert into ai_knowledge_doc (kb_id, doc_name, file_path, content_text, status, chunk_count, create_by, create_time, remark) values (#{kbId}, #{docName}, #{filePath}, #{contentText}, #{status}, #{chunkCount}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), #{remark})
mapper.delete: delete from ai_knowledge_doc where id in #{id}
delete from ai_knowledge_doc where kb_id in #{id}
